Legal

Privacy Policy

Last updated: August 2025 · POPIA Compliant

1. Introduction

Daisy Gadgets Co. is committed to protecting your privacy. This policy explains what personal information we collect, how we use it, and your rights under the Protection of Personal Information Act (POPIA).

2. Information We Collect

We collect: your name, email address, phone number, and delivery address when you place an order; payment proof uploads; messages sent via WhatsApp or our contact form; and website usage data via analytics.

3. How We Use Your Information

Your information is used to: process and fulfill your orders; communicate order updates via email and WhatsApp; respond to enquiries; improve our products and services; and comply with legal obligations.

4. Data Sharing

We do not sell your personal information to third parties. We share data only with: delivery partners (for shipping purposes); payment processors; and as required by law.

5. Data Security

We implement reasonable security measures to protect your data. However, no method of internet transmission is 100% secure. We use SSL encryption on our website and secure storage for all personal data.

6. Data Retention

We retain your personal information for as long as necessary to fulfill the purposes for which it was collected, including legal and accounting requirements — typically 5 years.

7. Your Rights (POPIA)

Under POPIA, you have the right to: access your personal information; correct inaccurate data; request deletion of your data; object to processing of your data; and lodge a complaint with the Information Regulator.

8. Cookies

Our website uses essential cookies for functionality (e.g., shopping cart). We do not use third-party tracking cookies.

9. Contact

To exercise your rights or for privacy questions, contact: daisygadgetsco@gmail.com or WhatsApp +27 82 587 6811.
